title: feat: extend model fallbacks across modalities
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #12986.

- Connects the shared fallback executor to model-selecting audio routes, embeddings, and 3D.
- Leaves fixed-provider audio operations untouched so a fallback never retries the same upstream under another model label.
- Leaves realtime unchanged because there is no current realtime fallback need.
- Declares no fallback pairs or model-specific compatibility, dimension, or price guards; registry declarations remain maintainer-owned.

Validation:
- Biome: clean
- Gen typecheck: pass
- Focused fallback, audio, embeddings, and 3D tests: 52 passed, 3 skipped
- Full Gen suite: 803 passed, 6 skipped

gist.headline: More routes, more escape hatches
gist.blurb: The fallback garden grew a few new paths. Audio model selection, embeddings, and 3D generation can now find another route when an upstream gets grumpy.
gist.summary: Connected the shared model fallback executor to model-selecting audio routes, embeddings, and 3D generation, while keeping fixed-provider audio operations and realtime behavior unchanged.
gist.impact: Audio, embedding, and 3D requests with registry-declared fallback models can recover through an alternate compatible model instead of stopping at a single unavailable upstream.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy multi-modal routing garden: Polli tends three code-plants representing audio waveforms, embedding vectors, and a tiny 3D cube, with gentle branching paths leading around a sleepy blocked-upstream sign toward healthy glowing terminals. The scene makes fallbacks feel like resilient garden paths rather than an error alarm; the Monitor Robot can happily point at the alternate routes.
